title: Start with Profit Mechanism, Not Strategy
text: You shouldn't literally never place a trade like that ever again. And there's a super important reason we start with a profit mechanism. But we can use a simple example. We can say something like generally speaking implied volatility is rich relative to realize volatility. That's the basis for the variance or volatility risk premium. From there we work down this chain of four questions to help us back into what structure helps us capitalize on our idea the best. The reason for this is you can have an idea and then based on your expression you literally could lose money because you use the wrong expression. You learn vertical spreads so then you say, well, I'm going to go trade this vertical spread. You find something that you think you can trade the vertical spread in and it's literally completely backwards.
